d:
PM Modi ki maujudgi men CM Samrat Choudhary ne manch se sanbodhan kiya. unke bhashan ke dauran karyakram men taliyan bajne lagin. aakhir CM Samrat ne apne sanbodhan men kya kaha aur kis bat par logon ne taliyan bajaeen? dekhie bhashan ka yah khas vidiyo.
About Channel:
ABP Bihar pradesh ki khabron ka ek aisa chainal hai jahan pradesh se juri har khabar aapke pas sabse pahle pahunchti hai. bihar ki rajniti, bihar ki barh, lalu - nitish ka ek dusre par palatvar, apradh ki andruni khabar aapke pas tathyon ke sath lekar aata hai.
